transcript:
Sample Sponsor Challenge (synthetic test image)
Track: Best Use of Open Transit Data
Build: a tool that helps commuters plan trips using public bus schedules.
Requirements:
1. Use at least one public transit data feed.
2. Work on a phone-sized screen.
3. Include a short demo video under 2 minutes.
Judging: usefulness 40%, technical depth 30%, design 30%.
Prize: $750 for the winning team.
